aria: Animated recap of the Trail Blazers' 123 to 103 home win over Oklahoma City: Damian Lillard's 30-foot 3-pointer with 1.1 seconds left in the third quarter, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 25 points with 13 in the third, the top scorers, how the Blazers won, and Wednesday's rematch with the Thunder.
notes: Box score from the Trail Blazers' 123–103 home win over the Oklahoma City Thunder on Nov 10, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (Anne M. Peterson, via TSN and KRMG), the AP's game story carried by 95.3 The Score (KUJZ), Portland Trail Blazers On SI, Roundtable Sports (via Yahoo Sports) and NewsBeep. All 123 Portland points and all 103 Oklahoma City points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (59–59 at the half and 97–80 after three, matching the AP). Bench points (38–32) are worked out from the box score's starters. Records and the Blazers' standing are from the site's standings; the rematch on Wednesday in Portland is from the AP.

Biggest lead: Portland's 22 (95.3 The Score). Oklahoma City's last lead was 71–70 on Ajay Mitchell's basket with 7:09 left in the third; Portland then scored nine straight, including Lillard's back-to-back threes for 79–71, and 18 of the next 22 (AP). The sources don't give the Thunder's biggest lead, so the reel doesn't show one. Lillard's 13 third-quarter points on 5-of-6 shooting are from On SI. Portland's second win over Oklahoma City in their last 21 meetings is from the AP story on 95.3 The Score. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (26 points, 8 of 22, 0 of 4 from three) sat the fourth quarter (AP), and so did Lillard (95.3 The Score).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Damian Lillard's 30-foot 3-pointer with 1.1 seconds left in the third quarter, after Deni Avdija's layup and three had made it 94–80 (95.3 The Score); Roundtable Sports (via Yahoo Sports) calls it a deep logo three as time expired and NewsBeep says it came from just inside the center-court logo. The line score confirms 97–80 after three. It is drawn as the template's pull-up from deep. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Portland Trail Blazers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Lillard’s listed 6-foot-2 and 200 pounds (FOX Sports roster), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-7.75 wingspan at the 2012 draft combine (NBADraft.net), in the Blazers' home white with No. 0 (FOX Sports roster) and his proposed look. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
